summary: One freeze used twice -> two freezes, refuted at X = poison
why: src's a - a is 0. tgt's two freezes of a poison X can choose apart, so tgt can return anything. The model agrees, and tests/freeze/FreezeModel.lean proves it doesn't refine, as freeze_duplicated_wrong. The claim says some way src chooses allows each way tgt chooses, which Lean can't decide at a witness, so tools/verify.py finds no counterexample, and reports the proof that failed.
